description:
Check a script before spending tokens. validate: the mechanical rules (hook first, exactly one hook, no placeholders/links/markdown/emoji/stage directions, hook terminal punctuation, word limits: total 60-200, content at least 30, hook 25-40 words; a CTA is a content take, placed anywhere), no tokens spent. score: a 0-100 score of a draft against your own measured posts, every point explained.
Actions and their required fields: validate (segments); score (draft).

action.description: What to do: validate | score. The description lists the fields each action needs.

draft.description: The text to score: a post body, or with kind "script" the video segments joined by newlines, hook first, then content takes.

kind.description: What the text is. Defaults to post.

network.description: Network the draft is for; the publish check uses that network's rules. Defaults to linkedin.

persona.description: The persona, by name or id (personas list shows both).

segments.description: The complete script as segments to validate mechanically, without spending tokens.

kind.description: Segment role: hook first, content after. Exactly one hook; a CTA is just a content take, placed anywhere.

media.description: Photos for this segment. Each item is mediaId (from media (action: upload)) or url (a public image URL). One image per ~3s of speech (~8 words); a 60s video needs ~20 images, split across segments (max 30). Full lip sync: max 6 images total. Each photo shows while its share of the segment is spoken: full frame on faceless videos, or a framed panel (~38% of the frame) at the bottom, face still showing. Optional duration (0.5-6s): on-screen seconds for a full-frame photo; omit for the 2s default. Optional overlay: an info card (title, subtitle, badge), e.g. a place name, address and price; a spoken caption sits above it, never on the photo.

badge.description: Short highlight such as a price or a year, shown as a pill above the title.

subtitle.description: Address or area, shown under the title.

title.description: The real place name, shown large on the card.

text.description: Spoken text only: no placeholders, links, markdown, emoji or stage directions.

videoType.description: The video mode the script is for: full_lipsync = media is optional (at most 6 images in total); hook_lipsync or faceless = images mode, which checks that every segment carries a media list, about one image per ~3s of speech (a 60s video needs about 20 images, at most 30). Omitted means hook_lipsync.

name: check_script
